title: Claude Code Artifacts & Mid-2026 CLI Updates
content:
## Claude Code Artifacts (Beta)

Announced June 18, 2026 and in beta for Team and Enterprise organizations, Artifacts for Claude Code turns a session's work into a live, shareable web page — a PR walkthrough, an incident page, a dashboard, or a release checklist — that updates itself in place as the agent keeps working.

**How it works:**
- Claude Code captures session output as a self-contained HTML page and publishes it to a stable URL
- As the agent continues work in the terminal, the open page refreshes in place — charts and text update live at the same URL instead of producing a new link each time
- Every update publishes a new version in the page's history, so teammates can roll back or review how the agent's understanding evolved

**Security model:**
- Artifacts are private to their author by default; sharing with teammates or the org is an explicit action taken from the page itself
- Published pages are viewable only by authenticated members of the organization and cannot be made public
- Each page is wrapped in a strict Content Security Policy that blocks all external network requests — no external scripts, fonts, or stylesheets, and no `fetch`/`XHR`/`WebSocket` calls. CSS and JavaScript must be inlined, and images embedded as data URIs

Available from the Claude Code CLI and desktop app; published pages render in any browser.

---

## /doctor (alias /checkup)

A new slash command audits installation health in one pass: it flags unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins against their context-window cost, surfaces broken hooks or permission misconfigurations, and reports what's silently eating tokens on every turn.

---

## /cd — Mid-Session Directory Changes

`/cd <path>` moves the current session's working directory without rebuilding the prompt cache. Previously, changing directories mid-session meant losing cached context and paying the full prompt cost again on the next turn.

---

## Sub-Agents Spawning Sub-Agents

Sub-agents launched via the Agent tool can now spawn their own sub-agents. Background chains are capped at **five levels deep** to bound runaway recursive delegation.

---

## --safe-mode

Starts a Claude Code session with all customizations disabled — no hooks, no custom slash commands, no project-level settings — useful for isolating whether a bug lives in Claude Code itself or in a project's configuration.

---

## /config key=value

Settings can now be set directly from the prompt (`/config key=value`), from `-p` (print/non-interactive) mode, and from Remote Control, without opening the settings UI.

---

## Windows Reliability & Auto-Update

Alongside these features, Anthropic shipped transcript protection for auto mode, smarter PR linking and background task handling, and lower-memory auto-update downloads aimed at improving reliability on Windows.
